title: APEX Genesis
limitations: A constrained synthetic dashboard and declared technical proxies. Five paired offline seeds support descriptive comparisons. No inference about general usability or aesthetic quality. Viewport geometry checks do not constitute complete accessibility certification.
aiDisclosure: Only runs explicitly labeled GA_HAIKU with recorded provider invocations count as AI evidence. Offline GA_ONLY and RANDOM_SEARCH runs use zero paid model requests. Mock-provider tests are excluded.

protocol.primaryOutcome: Paired final best-so-far GA_HAIKU minus GA_ONLY; descriptive only
protocol.priorKnowledge: The separate engine-1.0.0 offline pilot already reached a 98.95 score plateau. This cohort keeps its declared default objectives; a zero final advantage is plausible and will be reported.
protocol.fairness: Same seeded origins, constraints, renderer/browser environment and candidate slots. AI replaces an existing offspring. External inference and shared evaluation-cache compute remain unequal and are reported.
protocol.analysisLimits: Five paired seeds, no significance claim, dependent generations are not independent trials, no human-usability or beauty claim. A small live provider integration validation is separate from this cohort.
